### Do not edit between the hashtags ###

input the HK headers you want to log and the label they'll be assigned using the
below format.

'label' = 'header_ID'

An example is included below as well

sig_flow_SLPM = Sig_Cell_Flow

Note that all binary file paramters, including time, are logged by default

### Only edit below here, do not add any blank lines ###
task = Task
cal_mfc = Cal_SO2_MFC_Read
blc_flag_0 = BLC_0_flag
blc_flag_1 = BLC_1_flag
sig_cell_flow = Sig_Cell_Flow
cell_pressure = Cell_Pressure
ref_cell_flow = Ref_Cell_SLPM
